allow_large: Owner allowed (18 Oct): one docs-only path rule shared by the generated workflow, close and sync needs 6 code files
done_when: A pull request that changes only Markdown, docs/, plans/ or Forge's records skips the test suite in the generated workflow and at close, and the required tests check passes with a docs-only note, on new repos and after sync on existing repos
why: Every pull request runs the full test suite, even one that changes only Markdown, docs, plans or Forge's records
